verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents Experimentation with Bayesian winner and leading-variation analysis, but only as a product feature. The evidence never shows a programmatic interface for reading experiment configurations or results. The hosted MCP server is scoped to feature flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data, and the API-token docs describe generic read-scoped integrations without mentioning experiments, so both are adjacent building blocks rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: Configure the hosted MCP server so you can manage feature flags and AgentControl configs, and view observability data, directly from your AI client.
You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
LaunchDarkly highlights the leading variation when there is not yet enough experiment data to declare a winning variation.
